prompt: Use case: ui-mockup asset. Generate one transparent square icon atlas matching Titanium Blue reference's precise dark navy line icons. Exactly 6 columns and 6 rows equal cells, consistent centered glyphs occupy middle 55% of each cell with generous blank gutters. No labels or text. Row1 search magnifier, filter funnel, trash can, archive box, server rack, chain link. Row2 lightning bolt, right chevron, simple bridge, folder, robot head, chat bubble. Row3 task clipboard, horizontal bidirectional transfer arrows, audit document, plus, right arrow, left arrow. Row4 checkmark, X close, sun, moon, key, shield. Row5 logout arrow and door, circular refresh arrow, download, copy two sheets, eye, adjustment sliders. Row6 hamburger menu, package cube, padlock, person, warning triangle, connected nodes. Uniform crisp dark navy #172b50 thin strokes, no fills except tiny details, no backgrounds or grid lines. All symbols faithfully legible; no gradients.
